title: Board Approves Process that Could Pause Legislative Data Center & Substation Applications
summary: Loudoun County voted to consider a future resolution that, if approved, could pause final votes on certain data center and substation applications for up to one year.
evidenceText: voted in favor of future consideration of a resolution

title: Loudoun Board Opposes Valley North Transmission Line, Denies Substation Near Dulles Airport
summary: Loudoun County opposed a proposed transmission line and denied a land-use application for a substation near Dulles Airport.
evidenceText: denied land use applications for a new electrical substation near Dulles Airport

title: Governor Abbott Directs TCEQ To Halt Data Center Permits
